title: The Fog Lifts
script: It's 9pm. The Monday report is still open. The inbox keeps filling.
Something is happening inside your head.
Every unfinished task stays lit, a glowing fragment clogging the paths you think with.
You re-read, switch tabs, lose the thread, and stay late again.
Now imagine a team stepping in where the load builds.
Mochi, Kōhai's Chief of Staff, drafted it overnight. It waits for your approval before anything is sent.
The loop closes. The fragments clear, and the fog lifts.
Kōhai. Onboard AI colleagues. Get work finished.

title: The Whole Story
script: Third alarm. Five a.m. The house is still dark.
I'm an estimator. Numbers are my job, and the job doesn't wait.
My daughter's asleep when I leave. Too often, she's asleep when I get back.
Bid due Friday. RFIs stacking up, each one worded just right.
Lunch at my desk, over takeoff drawings, counting the same fixtures twice.
This morning was different. Overnight, Kōhai's team drafted the RFIs and the bid summary from the documents.
They wait in my Inbox. Nothing goes out until I approve it.
I left at five. I picked her up myself.
Tonight, I read the whole story. She fell asleep before the end.
